rationale: EO 9155 (Approving Regulations of the Civil Service Commission Relating to Efficiency-Rating Boards of Review, signed May 1, 1942, 7 FR 3277) approves regulations that became effective July 1, 1942 under their item 7. EO 9252, signed October 9, 1942 (7 FR 8079), approves replacement regulations and provides in its item 8, in the held Federal Register text, that its regulations supersede the regulations in EO 8748 and in EO 9155 and take effect immediately, with a retroactive exception limited to the successor-service provision of EO 9252 itself. The one history observation, the Federal Register disposition note "Supersedes: EO 8748, May 1, 1941 / Superseded by: EO 9252, October 9, 1942", agrees. Every numbered item of EO 9155 is a rule of the regulations that EO 9252 replaced, and none states an end earlier than that supersession except the effectivity provision of item 7, which was performed on July 1, 1942. Nothing in EO 9155 can be in force on 2026-10-14. Status: no.
